summary: @qlik/sprout-react preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled payload
details: The package declares a preinstall script (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases, extracts and chmod +x's the binary in a temp directory, and executes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. setup.mjs is variable-name obfuscated with hex identifiers (`_0x488df8`, `_0x52943e`) and indirection dictionaries characteristic of javascript-obfuscator output. math_init.js is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with a string-array shift decoder (`WV8StW`/`hc1jfK9`) and a large mixed numeric/string constant array. Fetching an alternate JavaScript runtime at install time to execute a bundled obfuscated payload has no relation to the package's stated purpose (a React component library) and matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern used to execute install-time code outside the reach of Node-only supply-chain scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
